phrase_step.description_2: Zelf removes the need for manual storage by encrypting your recovery phrase into a powerful, privacy-preserving ZelfProof. This ZelfProof is securely stored within a QR code that only you can decrypt, ensuring unparalleled security.

phrase_step.description_4: I understand that Zelf can help retrieve the QR code with ZNS. However, I am still responsible for safeguarding it to ensure secure access.
